dialogue.dialogue: Do you know what Evil Genius does for a living?
Just a few years back, he used to work for Company Inc LLC, designing all the technology they’ve invaded us with.
For a time, he really seemed to like his job– or at least, I think he did?? He made more coins than everyone in my family combined!
Anyways, one day, he told me he was having stomach pains and nightmares which made it hard for him to work.
He said that one of the nightmares was about a computer he designed coming to life?
Ever since then, he seemed really bothered about something, but he never could find the guts to quit.
Perhaps there is something too important for him to lose…
